camel_example: aliyun esa PutKvWithHighCapacity --region cn-hangzhou --Namespace test_namesapce --Key test_key --Url 'https://xxxobject.oss-cn-region.aliyuncs.com/9d91_xxxxxxxxxxx_158bb6e0f97c477791209bb46bd599f7'
description_en: Sets a single large-capacity key-value pair in a KV namespace. The maximum value size is 25 MB
description_zh: 设置KV存储空间的单个大容量键值对，最大支持25M的值内容
kebab_example: aliyun esa put-kv-with-high-capacity --namespace test_namesapce --key test_key --url https://xxxobject.oss-cn-region.aliyuncs.com/9d91_xxxxxxxxxxx_158bb6e0f97c477791209bb46bd599f7 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutKvWithHighCapacity

parameters.help_en: The name specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850317.html operation
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The key name to set. The key name can be up to 512 characters in length and cannot contain spaces or backslashes (/)
parameters.help_zh: 需要设置的键名称，最长不超过512个字符，不能包含空格、反斜杠（/）
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
A publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL that points to a JSON file containing the key-value pair to set. The server actively downloads the content from this URL.

If you use an SDK, the SDK automatically uploads the file and generates the URL.

In non-SDK scenarios, upload the JSON payload to any publicly accessible HTTP service and specify the URL.

The file content pointed to by the URL must be in the following JSON format: {"Namespace":"<namespace>","Key":"<key>","Value":"<value>"}
parameters.help_zh:
包含待设置键值对的JSON 文件的公网可访问 HTTP(S) URL，服务端会主动下载该 URL 内容。

如使用SDK，SDK 会自动上传文件并生成 URL

非SDK 场景请将 JSON payload 上传到任意可公开访问的 HTTP 服务后填入该 URL。

URL 指向的文件内容必须为如下 JSON 格式：{"Namespace":"<命名空间>","Key":"<key>","Value":"<value>"}
parameters.name: url

Length.description_en: The length of the value in the key-value pair

Value.description_en: The content of the key. If the content exceeds 256 characters, the first 100 and last 100 characters are returned with the middle portion omitted
Value.description_zh: 键的内容， 超过256个字符长度，将取前100及后100字符并省略中间
